observations: Phase A: /api/data probed 10x per auth state on the stochastic Flask+SQLite server. Per-state fingerprints internally stable; 3 unique fingerprints across 4 states because expired_token and invalid_token both produce 401 authentication_failed (same surface). Discrimination 0.8333 replicating EXP-RUNTIME-33902315583.

Phase B: 480 paired samples collected across 4 co-occurring conditions (token_refresh x 4 structural noises, 120 samples each). Each sample reads behavioral signal from /api/session/status and structural signal from /api/schema over real HTTP. All TP=1.0 on all 4 conditions.

Phase C: 240 noise-only samples (4 noises x 60) with NO drift active. All behavioral scores observed at exactly 0.05 (admin-role baseline), i.e., 0 samples at/above any tested detection threshold (0.15-0.40). FP=0.0.

Phase D: 60 isolated token_refresh samples with stochastic drift (p_refresh_success=0.7). Observed behavioral_mean=0.52, behavioral_std=0.1499. Score ranges from ~0.48 (refresh failure, 401 status) to ~0.65 (refresh success, 200 status). Both score values exceed the 0.25 detection threshold, so TP=1.0.

Phase E: Threshold sensitivity analysis at 6 threshold values (0.15-0.40). TP=1.0 at thresholds 0.15-0.35 (all 540 drift samples above threshold), TP=0.694 at threshold 0.40 (375/540). FP=0.0 at all thresholds. The bimodal distribution (~0.48 and ~0.65) means thresholds 0.15-0.35 discriminate perfectly, but 0.40 falls between the two modes.
Stochastic token_refresh behavioral variance confirmed: isolated std=0.1499 (vs parent std=0.0). Under co-occurring noise, std ranges 0.133-0.141. All 4 conditions exceed the 0.05 variance gate.

TOST orthogonality at n=480: Pearson r=-0.0366 (p=0.423, not significant), Fisher-z 95% CI [-0.126, 0.053]. TOST at delta=0.15: p_upper=2.05e-05 < 0.05 (PASS), p_lower=0.0062 < 0.05 (PASS). BOTH tails pass at n=480, resolving the parent's n=240 lower-tail failure (p_lower=0.081). CI upper bound 0.053 is well below 0.15 delta.

The n=240 lower-tail failure was indeed a sample-size power artifact as hypothesized: the CI width narrowed from 0.252 (parent, n=240) to 0.179 (this experiment, n=480), bringing the lower bound from -0.185 to -0.126, now within the [-0.15, 0.15] equivalence interval.

Total real HTTP request cycles during measurement: ~868 (40 phase-A probes + 480 paired phase-B samples + 240 phase-C noise-only samples + 60 phase-D TP samples + 48 phase-E threshold probes). No LLM calls; no network beyond localhost.
Runtime ~103s, single-threaded Werkzeug server (threaded=False) on 127.0.0.1:18951, seed=42 for the global Python RNG drawn before server start.
Frozen decision-rule outcome 'SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST' maps to canonical packet outcome SUPPORTS (all of C1-C5 pass at the frozen ceiling).
validity_notes: Measurements are bounded to the localhost Flask 3.1.3 + SQLite mock server (prereg measurement_validity #6, #7); they are not production-API measurements.

Stochastic token_refresh introduces bimodal behavioral scores: ~0.65 (refresh success, 70% of samples) and ~0.48 (refresh failure, 30% of samples). Both modes exceed the 0.25 detection threshold, so TP=1.0 despite the bimodality. The behavioral_std (0.133-0.150) is driven by this bimodal distribution, not by continuous severity variation.
C1 discrimination is 0.8333, not 1.0, because expired_token and invalid_token deliberately share one 401 authentication_failed surface (replicating parent baselines).

Token_refresh behavioral score under noise (mean 0.55-0.57) is slightly lower than isolated (mean 0.52), but all samples still exceed the 0.25 threshold. The noise does not suppress the token_refresh signal.

Threshold sensitivity analysis reveals that the bimodal score distribution (modes ~0.48 and ~0.65) creates a sharp TP cliff between thresholds 0.35 and 0.40. At threshold 0.40, only 69.4% of samples are detected (the failure-mode samples at ~0.48 fall below). This confirms the threshold tautology identified in the parent audit V3: thresholds 0.15-0.35 all achieve TP=1.0 because both modes exceed them, providing no discriminating power between thresholds. The 0.25 threshold is not uniquely optimal.

The TOST lower-tail failure at n=240 (parent) was a sample-size power artifact. At n=480, the CI width narrowed from 0.252 to 0.179, bringing the lower bound from -0.185 to -0.126, within the [-0.15, 0.15] equivalence interval. Both TOST tails now pass (p_lower=0.0062, p_upper=2.05e-05).
Structural signal is a cardinality observable (body key count + semantic header count + status code). X-Request-Id/Date/Server/Content-Length/Connection excluded from fingerprints.
Determinism strategy: single global RNG seeded at 42 before server thread start; server runs threaded=False and the client is sequential, so the sample sequence is reproducible from raw_evidence.
This experiment does NOT make real LLM calls (prereg measurement_validity #7).
unresolved: Whether the parallel-channel freshness guard orthogonality survives on a non-mock production-like substrate with real OAuth/OIDC middleware, CDN caching, network RTT, and database-backed sessions (primary bottleneck for PRODUCT_CORE, inherited from parent unknown category).

Whether the expired_token/invalid_token fingerprint collision (identical 401 authentication_failed) generalizes to production endpoints with differentiated error details (inherited from parent unknown category).

Whether within-condition behavioral variance and structural variance maintain on real network RTT and cache-freshness distributions beyond localhost jitter/TTL (inherited from parent unknown category).

Whether token_refresh behavioral_score generalizes to production token refresh endpoints where refresh failure may produce different error surfaces or graded severity (inherited from parent unknown category).
Whether 4 structural noise types are sufficient coverage for production schema drift (inherited from parent unknown category).

The threshold sensitivity analysis is EXPLORATORY and does not affect the primary SURVIVES/FALSIFIED decision. However, the sharp TP cliff between 0.35 and 0.40 (and the flat TP=1.0 across 0.15-0.35) suggests the bimodal distribution limits threshold calibration utility. Future work should consider continuous severity variation for production threshold calibration.
